svg.title: datawrench check on the bundled synthetic data repository
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal output of datawrench check on examples/check: two breaking changes to the enforced contract of model orders against the production manifest, a CREATE TEMP TABLE in a DuckDB migration that duckmate refuses and an empty down section, three slow Polars patterns, a seed ZIP column whose default Polars read drops leading zeros, and Singer tap output with a missing primary key, a wrongly typed field and no final STATE. Hand-drawn in the format of the check command, long lines shortened; not a recording.
svg.text: examples/check — synthetic dbt project, offline · illustrative, long lines shortened
